title: storyink 0.4.0: rich panels, code animation and SVG parity
subtitle: Commit b526d50, reviewed with its own diff. Render with --changes ../changes/storyink-0.4.0.changes.json

change.head: b526d50
change.title: feat: rich panels, code animation and SVG parity (0.4.0)

summary: 0.4.0 adds three rich node shapes (`panel`, `code`, `chip`), row and line anchors, and a content pass in the story engine (typing, line bars, status, levels, glows), with the animated SVG covering all of it. The change is large but **additive by construction**: the new palette and CSS are emitted only when a scene uses rich nodes, and a golden test pins pre-0.4 output byte for byte.

figure.claim: The new content pass sits beside the existing layout and story stages: every renderer reads the same scene, so HTML and animated SVG stay in step.

notes.src/core/story/content.ts: the content pass: type / set / line / status / levels

blocks.prose: Rich CSS and the rich palette are switched on per scene. `isRichScene` is the single gate both renderers consult:
The palette additions live in their own record, so the base `Palette` (and every pre-0.4 SVG) is untouched:

evidence.claim: Rich CSS / palette are only emitted for scenes that use rich nodes.
Rich palette is kept apart from `Palette` so pre-0.4 diagrams render byte-identically.
A golden test pins pre-0.4 output.
The animated SVG plays in Safari.

callout.title: Sound, additive release
callout.body: The gating is explicit and tested. The one open item is Safari playback of the animated SVG, which the changelog itself marks as untested.
